members.name: Yuricsa Romero Trigos
members.summary: Lawyer specialized in Constitutional Law with a master's degree in Reconciliation and Coexistence. She leads Orión Lex and handles private law, negotiation and dispute resolution matters.
members.description:
Lawyer specialized in Constitutional Law with a master's degree in Reconciliation and Coexistence. Her career has focused on private law, providing legal advice and support in resolving disputes between individuals.

As legal representative of Orión Lex, she combines the management of the firm with her professional practice. Her background allows her to approach conflicts from a perspective that combines legal analysis, negotiation and agreement building, with the aim of protecting her clients' rights and meeting their needs.

photo.alt: Yuricsa Romero Trigos, legal representative of Orión Lex

members.name: Sergio Ardila Rodríguez
members.summary: Lawyer specialized in Constitutional Law and master's candidate in Labor Law and Social Security. He designs litigation strategies and handles civil, administrative and public procurement matters.
members.description:
Lawyer specialized in Constitutional Law and master's candidate in Labor Law and Social Security. His experience includes legal advice to public entities, public procurement and court representation in civil and administrative law matters.

At Orión Lex, he leads the design of litigation strategies based on the analysis of each case, its evidence and the available procedural options. His work focuses on guiding the preparation of court proceedings, coordinating case follow-up and building a legal defense that responds to each client's needs and interests.

photo.alt: Sergio Ardila Rodríguez, strategic litigation director of Orión Lex
